=== enter between braces
--- before
function f() {¦}
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
function f() {
    ¦
}

=== electric closer
--- before
class A {
    m() {}
    ¦
--- keys
}
--- after
class A {
    m() {}
}¦

=== template literal
--- before
const s = ¦;
--- keys
`a
--- after
const s = `a¦`;

=== autoclose object
--- before
const o = ¦;
--- keys
{ a: 1
--- after
const o = { a: 1¦};

=== surround
--- before
const x = «a»;
--- keys
[
--- after
const x = [«a»];

=== surround quote
--- before
const x = «a»;
--- keys
"
--- after
const x = "«a»";

=== line comment
--- before
«let a = 1;
let b = 2;»
--- keys
<lc>
--- after
«// let a = 1;
// let b = 2;»

=== block comment
--- before
let «a» = 1;
--- keys
<bc>
--- after
let «/* a */» = 1;

=== no autoclose in string
--- before
const s = 'a¦';
--- keys
(
--- after
const s = 'a(¦';

=== arrow body
--- before
const f = () => {¦}
--- keys
<enter>return 1;
--- after
const f = () => {
    return 1;¦
}

=== generic angle
--- before
let a: Array¦
--- keys
<lt>number>
--- after
let a: Array<number>¦
